summary: Endovia Health Sciences filed an 8-K on October 15, 2026 disclosing a letter agreement with C/M Capital Master Fund, LP amending the September 19, 2025 Securities Purchase Agreement governing an equity line of credit. The amendment raises the beneficial ownership limitation from 4.99% to 9.99% effective immediately, and the parties waived notice and inconsistent provisions. Resales are registered on Form S-1 File No. 333-298112, effective August 24, 2026. No price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or closing date is stated. Watch potential dilution and ownership overhang from the enlarged cap.
